shared_elements: schematic linear signs arranged in a row
abstract geometric marks incised/applied on rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, low-detail abstract signs including circular/ring motifs and rows of linear marks, which is the only real correspondence. However A is a carved anthropomorphic statue whose body bears symmetrical paired motifs and a large disc arranged around a body form, while B is a flat rock panel with stick-figure humans, a crescent boat-like line with vertical strokes, and scattered signs — different subject matter, no human figures in B's manner appear in A, and no bodily framing in B.
